title.narrative: The CA has a clear overview of programme and can identify opportunities and issues with coherence and coordination; CA judges it is well supplied with information, expert advice and recommendations; projects have mutual visibility; EU and other key stakeholders understand EU contribution to CMR Programme and broader maritime security programming.

description.narrative: The CA has a clear overview of programme and can identify opportunities and issues with coherence and coordination; CA judges it is well supplied with information, expert advice and recommendations; projects have mutual visibility; EU and other key stakeholders understand EU contribution to CMR Programme and broader maritime security programming.

comment.narrative: The project is a third phase. The baseline of this indicator is the achievements of the second phase which were reached to a significant degree. For sake of clarity the baseline here is named Not at all to better display the evolution and progressive achievements of the project. Coordination coherence and complementarity levels between CMR projects and between CMR and external initiatives are as per the end of CRIMSON II as detailed in CRIMSON II Final Report November 2019.

By December 2023 coordination coherence and complementarity levels have increased significantly since the end of CRIMSON II with new efforts aimed at coordination and deconfliction and new dialogues and avenues in place and in regular use

title.narrative: To strengthen the trans regional coordination, coherence and complementarity effect among the various projects contained in the CMR Programme, both within the programme itself (CMR internal coherence) and with respect to any other relevant EU initiatives (EU internal coherence).Ultimately, increase the coherence with projects carried out or planned by EU Member States bilaterally or other international and regional (external coherence). Additionally, assess the CMR regarding the lessons learned and results reached by the implementation of the CMR

title.narrative: Positive qualitative judgements on the effectiveness, efficiency and coherence of the CMR Programme are made by evaluators and stakeholders; satisfaction of CA managers and stakeholders are satisfied with level of transregional coordination and complementarity among CMR (and external) components; CMR project leads/ stakeholders are satisfied with coordination and complementarity among CMR (and external) projects; senior EU stakeholders have the appropriate level of knowledge about the programme and maritime security.

comment.narrative: The project is a third phase. The baseline of this indicator is the achievements of the second phase which were reached to a significant degree. For sake of clarity the baseline here is named Not at all to better display the evolution and progressive achievements of the project.

By December 2023 coordination coherence and complementarity levels have increased significantly since the end of CRIMSON II with new efforts aimed at coordination and deconfliction and new dialogues and avenues in place and in regular use.
